{"category_edits":[{"category":"network_architecture","rationale":"Apply the fixed residual path h + 0.1*LayerNorm(h) to GRU outputs before the existing aggregation, with no affine parameters and padded outputs masked. This may stabilize hidden-state scale while preserving the GRU, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor already imports this model class from train.py, so it automatically uses the updated architecture.","edits":[{"find":"    def aggregate_states(self, out: torch.Tensor, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Prefix normalization yields weight 2**(-age/5) at every valid step.","replace":"    def aggregate_states(self, out: torch.Tensor, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        out = out + 0.1 * torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(out, (self.hidden_units,))
        out = out.masked_fill(seq.eq(0).unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)
        # Prefix normalization yields weight 2**(-age/5) at every valid step."}]}],"change_summary":"Add parameter-free residual normalization to GRU outputs in both training and inference, preserving all existing training and evaluation settings."}
